title: Test moderation end to end, then graduate: switch human moderation off when AI is trusted
description:
As a publication admin, I want evidence that AI moderation agrees with human moderators before I turn human moderation off, so that the switch is justified.

Plan: run AI and humans in parallel (AI in shadow or assisting mode) on the pilot, measure agreement, then disable human review. Report: agreement rate, overrides per week, false hides, escalation rate. Turning off is a setting change that stays reversible. Hard rule: bans and legal removals always keep a human path.

```gherkin
Feature: Moderation graduation
  Scenario: Agreement report
    Given AI and human decisions on the same items
    When I run the agreement report
    Then it shows agreement rate, overrides, false hides and escalation rate for the period

  Scenario: Switch off
    Given the agreement meets the configured threshold for the configured period
    When an admin sets human moderation to off
    Then the queue stops receiving routine items
    And overrides and bans remain available to moderators

  Scenario: End-to-end test
    Then an automated test covers submit, queue, approve, hide, ban and mode changes
```
